sections.purpose: Orient the reader to the whole chart with one concise synthesis; no object directory.
Present three to five ranked whole-chart themes that combine distinct structural evidence.
Show concise supportive and friction-bearing links without replaying core-theme explanations.
Explain which existing themes were prioritized for the selected customer intent; priority changes, meaning does not.
Reserve a separate location for governed temporal claims only when a separately authorized AST temporal input exists.
Expose method-native chart objects, geometry and technical labels as drill-down anchors without duplicating full explanations.
Expose source lineage, rule versions, digests, school choices and admission status in a collapsed technical layer.
